hypothesis.title: Fit 3-D planes to relocated hypocenters and test their uncertain surface projections
hypothesis.mechanism: A spatially coherent planar family of relocated hypocenters may delineate subsurface fault geometry whose uncertain surface projection indicates an unmapped trace; this is not simply 2-D event density.
layers: Public Nevada/nearby relocated hypocenters, subject to AOI coverage, field and license verification
Competition template features and visible-only fault catalogue, currently unavailable
hypothesis.named_non_fault_mimic: Aftershock or induced-seismicity sequences, volcanic/dike activity, mining blasts, and location artefacts may appear planar without representing a new surface fault.
hypothesis.mimic_control_process: Not run. Future test must quality-filter events, assess time/depth coherence and plane-fit uncertainty, use negative controls, and evaluate the feature alone on buffered whole-segment spatial folds.
hypothesis.novelty_rationale: Conceptually distinct from a 2-D epicenter-density transform; novelty relative to the shared stack and every prior raster is unverified because neither is present.
hypothesis.source_and_coverage_status: Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.11167510 is listed as CC-BY-4.0 for a Nevada/nearby catalogue, 2008-2023; exact competition-footprint coverage and local retrieval/integration have not been checked.
hypothesis.implementation_cost: Medium to high; 3-D clustering, robust plane fitting, uncertainty propagation, and surface projection.
hypothesis.expected_dti_note: No numeric forecast; no holdout experiment was run.
